mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to build a walk-in pantry?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for building a walk-in pantry varies based on its complexity, size, and material choices. A simple pantry addition might take a few weeks, while a more extensive custom build or renovation could take several weeks. Hometelligent Inc. provides a detailed project schedule during the planning phase, outlining each stage from demolition (if applicable) to final installation, ensuring clear expectations.
